name: plugin-mimi
description: Mimi's personal Claude plugins: life admin, communication and writing, creative crafts, coding and security, and core housekeeping skills.

plugins.name: life-skills
plugins.description: Bundled Skills to assist planning and management across life aspects: work, finance, friends & family, physical activity, mental activity, education / initiative projects.

plugins.name: soft-skills
plugins.description: Bundled Skills to assist the user in improving communication and writing skills, and broadening vocabulary and literacy skills.

plugins.name: mimi-core
plugins.description: Mimi's admin & housekeeping tasks for editing, reviewing, checking tech documentations for projects' codebase, progression tracks and general software practices e.g. CI/CD workflows on Github.

plugins.name: craft-skills
plugins.description: Bundled Skills for creative and reflective crafts: sprite cutting, animated stickers, mascot PFPs, project asset kits for Discord bots and app stores, daily astrology and tarot readings.

plugins.name: code-skills
plugins.description: Bundled Skills for coding: project breakdown into buildable subtasks, pull request review with Anthropic's code-review plugin as a dependency, and HIPAA readiness audits of Claude API integrations.
